summary.headline: Astrological Questions and Excerpts
summary.text: Catalog entries 173–193 of a Venetian astrological codex, covering travel, planetary testimonies and joys, zodiacal signs and erotic desire, lots, rays, hidden matters, midheavens, fortune, and questions about future events. It also lists excerpts from Theophilus, Valens, Dorotheus, and Anubion, with several cross-references to codex 6 and an appendix.
